d:
In this episode of The Lallantop Show, Abhishek examines the allegations of censorship against Meta and the questions surrounding press freedom and digital rights in India. What do Section 79(3)(b) and Section 69A of the IT Act say? What role do the IT Rules 2021 play? What did the Indian government's recent advisories to Meta say? And what do reports by the Internet Freedom Foundation (IFF), Reporters Without Borders (RSF) and SFLC.in reveal about content restrictions?
Production: Saurabh
Video Editor: Rahul
